RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly estimate a number from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. More years in news do not automatically mean a stronger match: digital expertise, leadership, and interview performance may legitimately distinguish candidates.

Follow up now on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and the reasons the successful candidate was preferred.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based comments, inconsistent criteria, or different treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition. If you might challenge the appointment, check local complaint deadlines promptly; waiting for an explanation may not suspend them.
